# Is your A/B test result real?

> Free A/B test significance calculator. Enter visitors and conversions to get the p-value, confidence interval, sample ratio mismatch check, Bayesian chance to beat control and an always-valid result for tests you peeked at. Plans sample size too. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
